title: Crown Jewels
features: 10 fixed win lines. Wins pay left to right on adjacent reels.
ROYAL CROWN is WILD — it substitutes for every symbol except the Treasure Chest, and doubles every win it completes.
TREASURE CHEST is a scatter — 3, 4 or 5 anywhere award 10, 15 or 20 FREE SPINS.
All free-spin wins are multiplied by 2.
After any win, try the GAMBLE: guess the card colour to double your win (up to 5 times).
